description: The values whose CBOR every backend's encode is pinned to before docs/adr/0101 moves anything (its step 0, section 8.3): every committed CBOR codec document, at a smallest and a largest value, and each optional entry present on the smallest value, so that every optional is pinned both ways. A value is an object of the codec's entries by id, an absent optional entry left out. A number is a JSON number; an enum is its variant's name, or a number for an open enum's value no variant names; a text is a string or {"fill": text, "count": n}; a byte string is hex or {"fill": hex, "count": n}; a list is an array or {"repeat": element, "count": n}; a record is an object of every field. A case may start from an earlier case of its codec (`base`) and add or replace entries (`with`). pin.py writes each value in deterministic CBOR for the drivers, and captured.json holds what each backend wrote for it.
